description: Bismarck Republican advances to the general election this fallBismarck, ND - Sean Cleary, a Bismarck Republican, has secured the Republican primary nomination for the State Senate in District 35. “I am grateful for all of my supporters and everyone who voted in this primary election,” Cleary said. “I look forward to earning the support from voters across the district this fall.” Cleary works for the Theodore Roosevelt Medora Foundation in Bismarck.
